Selected as the baseline for narrative/finding-continuity purposes (finding first-seen data, prior-result citations in report.md), but NOT marked machine-comparable: (1) target.commit_sha 25988f3e048ff3fd58336b4d9869c6fa8f0249b1 is not an ancestor of the current commit (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` fails) because the branch was rebased onto a new CH-03 base between that run and this one -- content-identity of the unchanged CH-04 implementation was instead independently re-derived this run via `git diff 25f60fa..HEAD` (25f60fa = the current, correct CH-03 base) reproducing the exact same 31-file/line diff review.md recorded, not by trusting the stale SHA; (2) target.environment materially changed -- the baseline run had zero live Postgres/Redis/MCP-gateway/ModelProvider access, while this run is authorized for and uses live Postgres, which is precisely why SEC-11 and SC-13 could move from UNVERIFIED to an evidenced result this run. Per audit-contract.md section 2, a materially incompatible environment sets comparable=false and every transition to NOT_COMPARABLE; the real trajectory (what moved, what stayed, what's new) is instead narrated with full evidence in report.md and in each affected observation, rather than asserted through the (here, honestly inapplicable) mechanical transition fields.
